protocol.source_validation: deterministic full-video sliding windows with 50% overlap
protocol.source_training_candidates: EMA proposals plus GT jitter in four IoU bands, BS-expanded proposals and true background proposals
protocol.source_training_windows: deterministic non-overlapping full-video coverage plus one final boundary-aligned window
protocol.source_epoch_sampler: 50% true background; foreground categories sampled equally
protocol.candidate_pipeline: EMA -> alpha -> hard class-agnostic NMS; proposal set fixed
protocol.plsr: FPN0 temporal RoI interpolation -> two Conv1d -> class and normalized start/end offset branches
protocol.excluded: AWL, target training, target classification, re-NMS, threshold or loss changes
